## 8e5125b84b87

**Reproduced contract defect.**  Generator SHA-256
`aa0eb0e01c4077a5f95a91e2e00e1f4a948280da8fb3b87acd729e0cd78009af`
finished the source-bound battery with 5 green, 2 advisory, and 5 failed stages.
Lint, defect lint, distribution, override, and authority synchronization failed.
The module has no `RULE_HASH`, accepts unknown override keys, and silently
accepts an invalid `texture` value by falling through to random layout behavior.
It also advertises broader exact domains than it honors: a hard 3x3 grid, a
medium 25x25 grid, `cyan_count=1`, `cyan_count=20` on 7x7, and
`decoy_palette_size=6` are all documented as legal but raise against narrower
default draw bounds.

The exact calls and exceptions are in
`checks/audit/8e5125b84b87/contract-reproducer.json`; the full battery summary is
`checks/audit/8e5125b84b87/battery/checks/8e5125b84b87_before_battery_summary.json`.
Rule smoke itself passed, so this audit does not claim an incorrect Racket label.
The target was not modified.
